question.text: Commodities used as alternative investment underlyings include:

answer.text: Metals (precious/non-precious), oil & gas, cash crops like cotton/coffee

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 1.2.5, alternative commodity investing includes metals, oil & gas, and soft commodities. The Trap: Narrow lists miss key commodities. Cross-Exam Context: Broad commodity universe. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Cat III AIFs can invest up to 10% of investable funds in one commodity (Ch 5).
